[[File:Training.jpg|thumb|Kyle Katarn and Mara Jade training in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] as part of their reciprocal apprenticeship.]]
'''Reciprocal apprenticeship''' was a form of mutual [[Padawan/Legends|apprenticeship]] between [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. A facet of the [[Concordance of Fealty]],<ref name="DFS">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref> a ceremonial expression of trust by the exchange of the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] of two Jedi,<ref name="Skye">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> [[Jedi Order/Legends|Order]] members rarely practiced the vow following the [[Cleansing of the Nine Houses]],<ref name="DFS" /> dated to the [[Old Sith Wars]].<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref>

To continue her [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] after abandoning the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], the former [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] undertook a reciprocal apprenticeship with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kyle Katarn]] as a way to teach the other in new techniques.<ref name="DFS" /> In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'', including the [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|mission to Dromund Kaas]], take place five [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after those of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], five years before [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Katarn fell to his darker urges after visiting the [[Dark Force Temple]],<ref name="DFS" /> hidden away on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Jade and Katarn's bond allowed her to [[Mission to Dromund Kaas (New Republic)|pull]] Katarn from the dark side of the Force.<ref name="MOTS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref> Although their shared bond saved Katarn in the moment, he continued his training with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and other Jedi, who could balance out his selfish instincts, unlike Jade.<ref name="DFS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bond first identified in the [[2005]] ''Dark Forces Saga'' blog supplement for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]. [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Jason Fry]] wrote the series of posts that featured details from across the [[Dark Forces/Jedi Knight]] [[Star Wars video games|video game series]].<ref name="DFS" />
